{{Quote|I'd suggest you blast your way into Nebula's corporate office in the Industrial Sector, grab some security slug, force him to tell you where Zee's at.|[[Gele'ren]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:CZ" />}}
The '''Nebula Communications security offices''' was the office of the [[Nebula Communications]] security company located in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:CZ" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]], a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] assaulted the Nebula Communications in search of their security expert [[Zee K'lin]].<ref name="TOR:CZ" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nebula Communications appear as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR:CZ" />
